artworks.title: The Anger of Achilles
artworks.description: David's moment before the sword — Athena staying Achilles' hand when Agamemnon seized Briseis.

artworks.title: The Wrath of Achilles
artworks.description: Rubens' Wrath of Achilles — the Iliad's opening quarrel when Agamemnon seizes Briseis and the plague still hangs over camp.

artworks.title: The Wrath of Achilles
artworks.description: Benouville's Wrath of Achilles — nineteenth-century restaging of the same rage that opens the poem.

artworks.title: Chryses Persuading Apollo to Send the Plague
artworks.description: Chryses persuading Apollo to send the plague — Iliad 1's opening wound: the priest's prayer that empties Achaean ranks.

artworks.title: Chryses Ransoming Chryseis from Agamemnon
artworks.description: Chryses ransoming Chryseis — the refused ransom that brings Apollo's arrows and Achilles' wrath into the same book.
